name: Mo'grosh Crystal
summary: In northeastern Loch Modan, Mo'grosh ogres mine and guard rare crystals with unusual alchemical properties. Dwarven engineers use them to neutralize Dark Iron explosives.

sections.title: A Rare Ogresh Commodity
sections.body: Mo'grosh ogres mine the crystals at their stronghold in northeastern Loch Modan. Though the clan favors brute strength over delicate metalwork, its members prize these stones. Enforcers, mystic shamans, and towering leaders carry them. The crystals are uncommon, so the ogres guard them closely within the Mo'grosh Stronghold.

sections.title: Countering the Dark Iron Threat
sections.body: Chief Engineer Hinderweir seeks a Mo'grosh Crystal, spider lurker venom, and crocolisk tears. He learned that Dark Iron saboteurs plan to attack the Stonewrought Dam. Dwarven engineers combine the mineral with those reagents to make a compound that disarms and defuses the volatile explosives before the valley can be flooded.

faq.q: Where do Mo'grosh Crystals come from?
faq.answer: Mo'grosh ogres mine and keep the crystals in northeastern Loch Modan. Any clan member in the Mo'grosh Stronghold might carry one, including mystics, brutes, enforcers, and shamans.

faq.q: What is the crystal used for?
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Hinderweir at the Stonewrought Dam needs a crystal for a neutralizing mixture. Combined with lurker venom and crocolisk tears, it disarms Dark Iron explosives meant to sabotage the dam.

faq.q: Why are the ogres mining these crystals?
faq.answer: Mo'grosh ogres mine rare crystals in the hills around their stronghold. What they use the crystals for is not recorded.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know defending the Stonewrought Dam takes ingenuity. Dwarven engineers turn the ogres' mined treasure into protection against Dark Iron treachery.
As a miner, you can tell these raw minerals come from deep within ogre territory. They react in unusual ways when combined with organic reagents.
